title: Flossing shouldn’t mean another 10-minute bathroom ritual.
description:
Flossing shouldn’t mean another 10-minute bathroom ritual.

When string floss feels fiddly on rushed mornings, a cordless water flosser with two pressure settings and about 45 seconds of floss time helps you clean between teeth without setting up a countertop unit.
